{{samename|[[character of the day]] from ''[[EP213|A Corsola Caper!]]''|Andrea}} [[File:Andreas.png|250px|thumb|Andreas]] '''Andreas''' (Japanese: '''トキオ''' ''Tokio'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP168|Hook, Line, and Stinker]]''. Andreas was a competitor in the [[Seaking Catching Competition]] in [[Johto]] who was also distinguished from his victories in other [[fishing]] tournaments. He had a very arrogant attitude, especially towards {{an|Misty}} and her {{TP|Misty|Poliwhirl}}. Andreas had a habit of calling Misty "Red", often referred to her Pokémon as weak, and claimed that his {{p|Poliwrath}} was far superior and would therefore win the competition. Misty and Andreas both ended up capturing a prize-winning {{p|Seaking}}. They had to battle each other to decide who would be the winner, with Misty using her Poliwhirl against his Poliwrath. Misty won, and Andreas, impressed with her victory, apologized to Misty. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Andreas |pkmn=Poliwrath |type1=Water |type2=Fighting |img=Andreas Poliwrath.png |epnum=EP168 |epname=Hook, Line, and Stinker |vajp=Unshō Ishizuka |vaen=Eric Stuart |desc=Andreas's {{p|Poliwrath}} is Andreas's only known Pokémon. It first appeared in a lake when it popped up next to {{TP|Misty|Poliwhirl}}, showing itself to be aggressive by punching Poliwhirl out of the water. It found its owner and then joined Andreas in a speedboat to start the [[Seaking Catching Competition]]. It used Double Slap to help Andreas catch his first {{p|Seaking}}, which was quickly released, as Andreas was not satisfied. Later, it used a Mega Punch to help capture a second Seaking. Andreas and {{an|Misty}} eventually both caught a prize-winning Seaking, and as a result, they had to battle each other to decide the winner. Andreas sent out Poliwrath and Misty used Poliwhirl. Before they could start, however, {{TRT}} stole one of the contest prizes, a large supply of chocolate. With the help of Poliwhirl, they made Team Rocket drop the bag of chocolate. Misty and Andreas resumed their match. Poliwrath used Submission on Poliwhirl, hurting it badly, but Misty encouraged it into continuing. Misty had Poliwhirl use {{m|Bubble}} and then follow up with {{m|Mega Punch}}. Poliwrath fell, but Andreas had it use Mega Punch as well. Poliwhirl dodged it and used Bubble again, followed by a {{m|Water Gun}} that knocked out Poliwrath. Poliwrath's known moves are {{m|Double Slap}}, {{m|Mega Punch}}, {{m|Submission}}, and {{m|Water Gun}}.}} ===Temporary=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Andreas |pkmn=Seaking (×2) |type1=Water |img=Andreas Seaking1.png |cap=Andreas's Seaking |img2=Andreas Seaking2.png |cap2=Andreas's Seaking |epnum=EP168 |epname=Hook, Line, and Stinker |desc=Andreas hooked these {{p|Seaking}} as a part of the [[Seaking Catching Competition]]. He got the first one by having his {{p|Poliwrath}} use {{m|Double Slap}} on it, but it was quickly released because he found it to be just a warm up and it was too small. Andreas hooked a second Seaking and had his Poliwrath's {{m|Mega Punch}} knock it out. He was satisfied with this one, and it turned out to be a prize-winning Seaking, weighing no more than 55 kilograms. Misty hooked one of the same weight, however, so the winner could not be directly decided. They had to battle each other to find out who would be the winner. Seaking was later released under the competition's rules.
